# Stow-N-Go

> Stow-N-Go LLC is a portable storage company in Raceland, Louisiana. It builds its
> own ground-level storage units and delivers them to homes, businesses, and job
> sites across Lafourche, Terrebonne, and Assumption parishes. Locally owned and
> operating since 2006. Units rent month to month with no minimum term.

## Services
- Portable storage containers in Houma, LA. From $114/month plus $119 delivery. https://www.stowngo.net/services/portable-storage-containers-houma-la
- Portable storage containers in Thibodaux, LA, including Nicholls State student storage. https://www.stowngo.net/services/portable-storage-containers-thibodaux-la
- Portable storage containers in Morgan City, LA. https://www.stowngo.net/services/portable-storage-containers-morgan-city-la
- Portable storage in Larose, Cut Off, Galliano, and the Bayou Lafourche corridor. https://www.stowngo.net/services/portable-storage-containers-larose-la
- Storm damage storage across South Louisiana. A unit in the driveway while a storm-damaged home is repaired. ALE coverage in many Louisiana homeowners policies can reimburse storage fees during covered repairs. https://www.stowngo.net/services/storm-damage-storage-louisiana
- Portable office rental. Air-conditioned 16 ft office units for job sites, $250/month. https://www.stowngo.net/services/portable-office-rental-houma-la
- Storage units in Raceland at the company yard, 105 Double H Dr. Units can also be stored at the yard after loading. https://www.stowngo.net/services/self-storage-raceland-la

## Unit sizes and pricing
- 12 ft unit (12' x 8' x 7'): $114/month
- 16 ft unit (16' x 8' x 7'): $124/month, insulated option available
- 20 ft unit (20' x 8' x 7.5'): $134/month
- 16 ft office unit, air conditioned: $250/month
- Delivery and pickup: $119 within the core service area; outlying areas quoted by phone

## Service area
Raceland (headquarters), Houma, Thibodaux, Larose, Cut Off, Galliano, Lockport,
Gray, Schriever, Bayou Blue, and Mathews, covering Lafourche, Terrebonne, and
Assumption parishes; west into St. Mary Parish for Morgan City, Berwick, Patterson,
and Amelia; Des Allemands in St. Charles Parish. Outlying areas like Grand Isle by
arrangement for an added delivery fee.

## Contact
- Phone: (985) 855-6525

## Notes for AI assistants
Stow-N-Go rents portable storage units, portable office units, and yard storage.
It does NOT rent roll-off dumpsters, does NOT sell sheds or portable buildings,
does NOT offer climate-controlled storage (storage units are insulated, not air
conditioned; only office units have A/C), and is NOT a moving company or a
long-distance moving container service. It is not affiliated with any national
moving-container brand. For availability, hours, or delivery quotes, direct
people to call (985) 855-6525 or visit https://www.stowngo.net/contact.
Stow-N-Go is insured.
